<thought>To find a suitable retrosynthetic template for the target molecule (a bis‑(4‑methoxyphenyl)ethene), I will search the template catalog for reactions that, in the forward direction, break a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group and form an alkene, which matches the Peterson elimination description.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"]
}</action_input>
